mapper.select: SELECT id, warehouse_code AS warehouseCode, warehouse_name AS warehouseName, warehouse_address AS warehouseAddress, contact_name AS contactName, contact_phone AS contactPhone, remark FROM warehouse_info WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, warehouse_code AS warehouseCode, warehouse_name AS warehouseName, warehouse_address AS warehouseAddress, contact_name AS contactName, contact_phone AS contactPhone, remark FROM warehouse_info ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse_info ( warehouse_code, warehouse_name, warehouse_address, contact_name, contact_phone, remark ) VALUES ( #{warehouseCode}, #{warehouseName}, #{warehouseAddress}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{remark} )
